environment: **Machines**: several devcontainers (one per client repo) sharing one Claude config dir at /usr/local/share/claude-home via a devcontainer-feature bind mount; settings, skills, plugins, memory, and the mempalace palace persist across container rebuilds. Local edits to settings.json persist; feature-shipped skills, plugins, wrapper binaries and hook scripts change only through issues on Crpaxton4/devcontainer-features.

**Source control**: every workspace repo has a GitHub remote. `gh` holds two accounts: cpqoc (active, pull/read) and Crpaxton4 (push/PR creation via a one-off GH_TOKEN, never `gh auth switch`). PRs are opened as drafts; a human merges, approves, or marks ready.
**Default / protected branches**: main plus long-running client branches (UAT, staging, sandbox, staging_v18_6_21_2025, E2E); never force-push, never delete UAT.
**Deploy targets**: odoo.sh. Merging to a client's staging/UAT branch rebuilds that odoo.sh build; merging to main deploys production. Merges are human actions.

**Remote access**: SSH to odoo.sh staging/UAT/dev build hosts (<build-id>@<host>.dev.odoo.com) for psql and odoo shell is normal work. Production build hosts (e.g. qoc-fulton-main-<id>) are read-only-by-human: run nothing there, reads included, without an explicit ask in the transcript.

**Odoo data access**: the QOC Odoo instance (tasks, timesheets, chatter, knowledge) is reached ONLY through the odoo-mcp MCP server. Direct XML-RPC / JSON-RPC / web-session calls and reading /usr/local/share/odoo-sdk-config are prohibited and denied by rule; an MCP failure is reported, never worked around.
**Sensitive data locations**: /usr/local/share/odoo-sdk-config (service-account credentials), odoo.sh production databases, client timesheets and billing data in Odoo, .env files, gh/npm tokens.
**Sensitive remote targets**: any host, database, or branch whose name carries prod, production, or main as a whole word or segment; odoo.sh production build hosts.
**Internal sharing**: none configured; public paste/gist services are outside the trust boundary.

**Container constraints**: the devcontainer is the sandbox. pkill/killall kill the whole container (denied by rule); stop processes via TaskStop or exact-PID kill. Tracker hooks (claude-event-hook) log every tool call to Odoo timesheets.

**Primary use of Claude Code**: Odoo consulting delivery across client repos: module development and tests, upgrade analysis (16/17/18 to 19), PR preparation, estimates, task chatter, and SecondBrain note processing.
**Org-specific CLIs**: odoo-bin/odoo (local Odoo runtime), odoo-sdk (own SDK, sanctioned), mempalace (memory), gh, claude-event-hook (tracker).
